:::{#sol-bernoulli-score-contribution}

The [score](#def-score) contribution is the score of the single [observation](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-observation) $\outvar_\iobs$,
so @thm-bernoulli-score with $x = \outvar_\iobs$ gives

$$
\begin{aligned}
\score_\iobs(\prob)
&= \deriv{\prob} \llik_\iobs(\prob)
&& \text{(definition of the score contribution)}\\
&= \frac{\outvar_\iobs - \prob}{\prob(1 - \prob)}
&& \text{(score of a Bernoulli variable)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
